# Can Taste Become Institutional Knowledge? — finished platform kit

## 1. LONG VIDEO
Begin with “I just know.” Rewind the statement into comparison, touch, memory, constraint, contributor, rejection, and correction. End with the right not to record.

## 2. SHORT 01
“Taste is not magic. But it is not merely a spreadsheet either.” Show evidence, embodied judgment, and irreducible uncertainty together.

## 3. SHORT 02
“The most important institutional field may be disagreement.” Give one collaborator a documented override route.

## 4. CAROUSEL
ELICIT / DEMONSTRATE / ATTEMPT / CORRECT / COMPARE / CONTEST / CONSENT / GOVERN.

## 5. AUDIO
A practitioner-led oral-history prompt focused on decisions and boundaries, with pause, embargo, attribution, and withdrawal choices.

## 6. WORKSHOP
Run one judgment through founder, maker, wearer, accessibility, cultural, and archive lenses; preserve dissent rather than average it away.

## Claim ledger
- **VERIFIED:** FIT preserves practitioner testimony about patternmaking knowledge, training, technique, technology, and industry practice. (S72, S73)
- **VERIFIED:** Copyright protection for a useful article is limited to qualifying separable pictorial, graphic, or sculptural expression; it does not make taste itself copyrightable. (S91, S92)
- **PROPOSAL:** Institutional taste should preserve dissent, provenance, consent, and revision—not only the founder’s preferred answer. (S72, S88)

## Publication discipline
Do not invent production arrangements or add unlicensed imagery. Preserve captions, alt text, creator and institution credits, canonical URLs, evidence labels, labor and jurisdiction limits, participant correction, and counsel or specialist gates.
